title: Test 04 — four floor sizes, five buildings each
selection: Per group and size (3/6/9/12 flats/floor), 5 usable buildings whose declared plate area is nearest n x 60 sqm/flat are taken, skipping a building already used by a smaller size in the same group; each drawn at the imposed count.
